findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.comment: Observed several dented cans on the shelves. The cans were removed from service and the PIC was educated. Ensure that food packages are in good condition to protect the integrity of the food.
findings.citation_text: 3-202.15 Package Integrity. FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
Observed the following non-food contact surfaces require cleaning:

(1) The debris underneath the glass portion behind the Jolly Rancher frozen beverage machine nozzles.

(2) The debris behind the slushy machine nozzles.

(3) The dust and other debris on the shelves inside the walk-in drink cooler. 

(4) The debris behind the cappuccino machine nozzles. 

(5) The surface above the coffee pot. 

Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned at a frequency necessary to avoid the accumulation of debris, dust, and other residues. Ensure that the above referenced are cleaned to sight and touch by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices.
findings.comment: THIS IS A FIRST REPEAT VIOLATION: Observed there is a leak at the triple sink faucet. Ensure that the leak is repaired by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 5-202.11(A) Approved System and Cleanable Fixtures. (A) A PLUMBING SYSTEM shall be designed, constructed, and installed according to LAW.

findings.title: Toilet facilities: properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed there is not a covered waste receptacle in the female toilet room for sanitary napkins. Ensure that the female toilet room has a covered waste receptacle by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 5-501.17 Toilet Room Receptacle, Covered. A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: THIS IS A FIRST REPEAT VIOLATION:
findings.citation_text:
6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions.  The facility is observed to have soiled floors and shelving due to a previous mouse infestation. Originally noted in the 2023 inspection, evidence of current presence was observed throughout the facility. During today’s inspection, there is observed mouse droppings throughout the entire back storage area (from around the soda service station to the opposite alcohol and office space). There are not any large numbers. And droppings appear to be old. There was also an old dead mouse under the soda boxes. This is a cleaning issue. Cleaning will need to be extensive and thorough. Remove all the bulk boxes of sundries from the back storage space and clean the floor. SCDPH will allow thirty days for compliance to allow for detail cleaning. As part of cleaning, see that the walls around the soda syrup storage shelf are cleaned and painted as required. Soda splash is observed around the wall behind the syrup boxes and on the ceiling above the shelf. 
Finally, the floor drain of the hand sink behind the soda service station is observed soiled with mold growth.
Clean the aforementioned areas paying particular attention to the soda syrup storage area. 

 (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. The back room is observed to have damage to several ceiling tiles directly over the soda syrup box shelf. The ceiling tiles should be replaced and best practice would be to use a vinyl coated tile - to allow for proper cleaning. In addition to the cleaning to address the previous pest problem (see other 55 violation) maintenance should be conducted to insure surfaces are properly sealed to prevent entrance of pests. There are observed several holes in walls around the alcohol storage across from the office space and around the soda syrup boxes. As you clean, seal any observed holes with steel wool. The use of spray foam is allowed, but mice will chew through this material. 
Furthermore, several of the acoustic tiles in the back storage room are observed water stained from water damage. Replace the ceiling tiles with ones that are in good repair.

The wall holding the shelving with mouse droppings is observed to have mold and mildew damage. Discussed using a Kilz or similar product to seal the wall to prevent further growth. 

(A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.
